end.summary: Practised levels of organisation: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
end.parentNote: Asha practised human examples, including stomach as an organ and the digestive system as a group of organs. Yash initially mixed up a single organ with an organ system, then corrected this by identifying the heart, blood vessels, and blood as parts of the circulatory system. They also explained that cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs form systems; at home, ask them to make one human and one plant example for each level.
